games.name: Pixel Quest [RPG]

After 1x1x1x1 destroyed the Third Dimension, the Robloxians had no other choice than to flee to the 2D world. However, 1x1x1x1 wasn't satisfied and is now set on destroying this pixelated world next. Expect Bugs and Changes. I hope you join us on our journey. UPDATES EVERY WEEKEND!

[How to Play]
- Shoot and Dodge Projectiles!
- Find Loot and Level up!
- Complete Quests and Clear Dungeons with friends!
- Decide on power ups that will decide your fate!
- When you are defeated in battle, earn Valor Tokens to spend on Cosmetics and power ups for your next character!

Pixel Quest is a 2D Open World RPG focusing on Bullet Hell combat with Roguelike elements.

games.name: QUICKDRAW: LEGACY
games.desc:
READ THE DESCRIPTION BEFORE PLAYING.

Bullet comes out of the barrel, there's no fixed reticle (like a crosshair). You can shoot through walls, depends on the material & thickness. Movement sways the arms & torso, causing the "fire spread" (there's NO RANDOM spread).

Scroll (UP/DOWN) or 1/2 - pick items from inventory
Q (PRESS) - equip/unequip Q (HOLD) - quickdraw state
Q + LMB (HOLD) - quickdraw
LMB (GUN EQUIPPED) (HOLD) - fire
RMB (GUN EQUIPPED) (HOLD) - focus
R (GUN EQUIPPED) (IN QUICKDRAW STATE) - switch to regular mode
R (GUN EQUIPPED) (PRESS/HOLD) - single/full reload
LEFT SHIFT (HOLD) - slow walk
LEFT CONTROL (HOLD) - crouch
RETURN - Popup on bottom left on death to go back to main menu.

LMB/RMB = R2/L2
Scroll = DPAD
Q = ButtonA
R = ButtonY
Z = ButtonX
Left Shift = ButtonL1
Left Control = ButtonR1

Mobile support exists, and you can rebind/change your layout in settings.

games.name: Aeronautica
games.desc:
Train, Buy, Fly - Aeronautica is an open-world flight simulator with economy elements where the goal is entirely up to you. Earn money by completing unique jobs or flights between distant islands and continents. You can even create an airline for you and your friends to join! 

Train and earn licenses to unlock exciting new vehicles. Customize and maintain your vehicles as you work your way up from the smallest ultralights to the world’s largest airliners like the Airbus A380 Superjumbo. 

In Aeronautica you can explore:

> ✈️ 800+ unique vehicles in 10 different classes to unlock. Ranging from airliners to ultralights, and fighter jets to boats 
> 🛫 210+ airports and heliports, ranging from dirt runways to large international airports 
> 💸 Custom player-run airlines for you and your friends 
> 📈 Fluctuating player-driven markets where you can sell your acquired aircraft and parts 
> 🎨 Customizable liveries and vehicles
> ⛈️ Dynamic weather
